findings.canonical_conflict: Current data/API docs define AI as valid response and checked_at as finish time; preclaiming AI/checked_at before HTTP and keeping AI on timeout changes that contract. SourceSKIPPED failure rule and AI-only-row hard-attempt counter cannot both account for failed attempts/deleted rows without reconciled persistent accounting semantics.
findings.owner_options_under_lead_review: Lead asks to preserve SKIPPED/UI and use durable attempt journal in existing audit, or change AI source semantics plus deletion-safe journal. No new counter table; no limit reset/raise; no guard/permission weakening. No option assumed approved.
